row.headline: ADNOC celebrates 55 years of powering UAE growth as it advances $150 billion investment plan through 2030
row.summary: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) is celebrating 55 years of contributing to the UAE's economic development by transforming natural resources into long-term economic value. The company is advancing a $150 billion investment plan through 2030, focusing on energy infrastructure, national talent, industrial capabilities, and advanced technologies.
